theme_strategy.rationale: Travel apps require high readability outdoors under direct sunlight (Travel Mode). Light theme provides optimal legibility. Dark mode should be available but default to light.
theme_strategy.aesthetic: Organic & Earthy (Archetype 1) - avoiding neon AI-slop, focusing on calm, friendly, and adventurous tones.

rules.no_gradients: Do not use full-screen or button gradients. Use flat, solid colors for a premium, grounded feel.
rules.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large text. Strictly adhere to WCAG AA for outdoor readability.

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter or Roboto for headings. Keep typography warm, legible, and slightly rounded (Manrope).
rules.travel_mode_override: In 'Travel Mode' toggle, increase body text size by 1 step (to text-lg) for glanceability.

layouts_and_grids.navigation: Fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile (h-16, safe-area-padding, solid background with 1px top border). Desktop uses a sidebar or top navbar.
layouts_and_grids.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-4 for dense mobile lists, but p-6 to p-8 for discovery cards.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: For Destination Discovery: Use asymmetrical grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, varying spans) to create visual tension and editorial feel.
layouts_and_grids.containers: Rounded-xl (12px) for cards, minimal shadows. Rely on 1px borders (#E5E1D8) to define edges rather than heavy drop shadows.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), solid Forest Green background, white text. Active state scales down slightly (-translate-y-0.5 is for hover, scale-95 for active).
buttons.secondary: Outline with 1px border, transparent background, text color matches border.

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces. No muddy shadows. Use border-border border.
cards.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 with a soft, diffused shadow (shadow-md).

surfaces.glassmorphism: Avoid excessive glass. Use only for sticky map controls (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20) to maintain map visibility.
surfaces.travel_mode: Cards turn full-width, borders disappear in favor of hard divider lines to maximize screen real estate.

map_ui.controls: Floating UI controls over the map. Search results should add markers without aggressively moving the map center (viewport stability).
map_ui.markers: Use custom HTML markers (divIcons) styled with Tailwind, avoiding default blue Leaflet pins.

visual_enhancers.motion: Fast, purposeful micro-interactions. 200ms ease-out transitions. No bouncy/springy animations. Itinerary drag-and-drop should feel snappy.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a clean, consistent, and slightly playful look.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use subtle ASCII art or minimal line illustrations instead of generic 'no data' vectors.

hero_marketing.description: Silhouette of man walking along field leading to mountain at sunset.

destination_discovery_2.description: Solitary tree on a dry hill, calm isolation.

local_discovery_cafe.description: Warm and inviting coffeeshop filled with rustic wicker elements and plants.

coco_ai_avatar.description: Abstract friendly glowing blue/teal sphere representing COCO the AI.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Progressive Disclosure: Do not show all trip details at once. Use accordions or tap-to-expand for itinerary days.
Implement 'Travel Mode': A specific UI state (toggleable) that simplifies the interface for on-the-go use. Larger fonts, higher contrast, fewer distractions, prominent 'What can I do right now?' CTA.
AI Integration: Treat COCO as a companion. Avoid generic 'AI Sparkles' everywhere. Chat UI should feel like a messaging app (e.g., iMessage/WhatsApp), not a corporate bot.
Map implementation: Use react-leaflet. Keep the map stable. Do not auto-fly-to coordinates aggressively unless explicitly requested by the user.
Do not use transparent dropdowns or transparent sticky headers without backdrop blur and an explicit background color (e.g., bg-white/90).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='generate-trip-button').
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing landing page (no Shadcn wrappers), but use Shadcn for the app dashboard (forms, inputs, dropdowns).

accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all transitions.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Use text-shadow over images if necessary.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-colors or transition-transform.
Never apply text-align: center globally to the app container.
Avoid AI slop: No AI-bot emojis, no meaningless gradient blobs, no oversized text everywhere.
Ensure all components from src/components/ui are properly configured and customized to match the brand identity (remove default Vercel/Stripe look).
